name: Koiiro Soramoyou
source:
The protagonist, Itou Seigo, son of famous scientists, due to his parents' circumstances and the construction of Kamina Bridge, moved from Tokyo to Kamina Island and transferred to Kamina Academy. He reunited with his childhood friend and stepsister. Moreover, in peculiar circumstances, he also met a cold beauty, wielding a Japanese sword; a member of the Disciple Committee with blond hair, who has an aura of seduciness around her; and the daughter of a rich family, who is also the head of the student council. And so his rich school life truly began, filled with hassles from the Disciple Committee, dreadful guards of school discipline, led by the severe and ruthless teacher Serizawa.

...But good things never last long. Following the arrival of the mysterious person on the island, cruel events began to occur one by one. At the beginning, Seigo was rather indifferent, since he had not much attachment to his new environment, yet the distress developed and involved the whole island. Not even his friends were left untouched...

Seigo felt fury against unreasonable adults and made a decision to fight for the academy and the whole island, which were precious to his dear friends.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://dic.pixiv.net/a/%E6%81%8B%E8%89%B2%E7%A9%BA%E6%A8%A1%E6%A7%98]pixiv[/url]]
translation:
主人公伊东诚悟是著名科学家的儿子。由于父母的安排以及神那桥的建设，他从东京搬到神那岛，并转入神那学园。在那里，他与青梅竹马和继妹重逢；又因各种特殊情况，认识了手持日本刀的冷艳美人、浑身散发诱人气息的金发风纪委员，以及出身富裕家庭、同时担任学生会长的大小姐。就这样，他丰富多彩的校园生活真正开始了；严厉无情的芹泽老师率领可怕的风纪卫队，不断给他制造麻烦。

…然而，好景从不长久。随着一名神秘人物来到岛上，残酷的事件接连发生。起初，诚悟对新环境并没有多少感情，因此态度较为冷淡；但事态不断恶化，最终波及整座岛屿，连他的朋友也无法置身事外…

面对蛮不讲理的成年人，诚悟怒不可遏，决定为了学园和整座岛屿而战——那里是他珍视的朋友们最重要的地方。
